_note: Episode 1 'The Soul That Died' scripture cards. KJV (public domain). 'cue' = words in the sermon where the card fades in (matched against the cut's word timestamps at assembly). Shown ~7 s.

cards.chapter: Can A Soul Come Back To Life?
cards.cue: and god said let us make man
cards.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

cards.cue: let this mind be in you
cards.text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.
And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins.

cards.cue: baptize you with the holy ghost
cards.text: He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire.

cards.cue: but of the tree of the knowledge
cards.text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
Literally, a moving of the mind or soul; hence, any agitation of mind or excitement of sensibility.
Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

cards.cue: bear the inequity of the father
cards.text: The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son.

cards.cue: but if the wicked will turn
cards.text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee.
And the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

cards.cue: that same spirit that raised up
cards.text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

cards.cue: every man that have this hope
cards.text: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
